name: @coding-adventures/mosaic-flux-html
description: Strict-Flux runtime for Mosaic UI's HTML emitter. Same core types as mosaic-flux-react (MosaicAction, MosaicStore, middleware, createSelector, devToolsMiddleware); replaces React hooks with vanilla-DOM binding helpers (bindText, bindAttr, bindClass, bindStyle, bindList).
author: Adhithya Rajasekaran
